items.title: El-Sayed Apologizes for March Comment About Michigan Synagogue Attack
items.author: Steve Friess and Tim Balk

items.author: Miriam Jordan and Hamed Aleaziz

items.author: Anupreeta Das, Sajal Pradhan and Binod Ghimire
